## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON with cyclical tilt; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Energy and Materials leading while top performers skew cyclical (VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND) and Communication strength (NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND); leadership concentration: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +16.76%) ABOVE TREND.  
Communication lead: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials showing strength: DOW (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Financials lag: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND, sector down on 1W.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND.  
Technology mixed/soft: NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated across Communication, Technology and Energy.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +9.08%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.79%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select discretionary and semicap names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND; major divergence: NFLX has negative insider-sale headline (sentiment -40) despite ABOVE TREND — watch for distribution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with clear short-term bifurcation: PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND vs NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND and ASML (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.79%) BELOW TREND; several large-cap techs in RECOVERY (MSFT (1W: +1.15% | 1M: -4.07%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +2.15% | 1M: -5.48%) RECOVERY) — Sector breadth: Technology positive on 1W but mixed over 1M.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are soft on 1W with pockets of stress: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and broader financial sector negative; V (1W: +2.39% | 1M: -3.81%) RECOVERY and MA (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY show bifurcation — watch for earnings/cycle cues.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Relatively stable/defensive tone: UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND flags stock-level risk; sector shows modest strength on 1W.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor cyclical/value exposure given Energy and Materials leadership (VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to structurally weak/dislocated tech and consumer discretionary names (AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but monitor tech rebounds.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: Energy positive; multiple names ABOVE TREND) and Materials.  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Semiconductors/Tech equipment where several names show BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND — watch breach of recent 1W low for acceleration.  
AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND — watch re-test of 1M support for continuation of weakness.  
NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND — watch close above recent breakout pivot for momentum follow-through.  
JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND — watch hold/failure of 1M support for financial risk signal.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
BA (+55): Boeing (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND — bullish order headlines but price remains BELOW TREND, a divergence to monitor.  
DE (+55): Deere not in detailed list for dual timeframes here but related industrials (DOW (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND) confirm industrial tailwinds.  
(Headline-driven names show sector confirmation in Industrials/Energy; where price is ABOVE TREND the sentiment is confirming, otherwise watch for follow-through.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
NFLX (-40): Netflix (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND — bearish insider-sale headline diverging from strong price action (distribution risk).  
UNH (-45): UnitedHealth (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — negative governance/cost headlines but price remains ABOVE TREND, monitor for sentiment bleed.  
RCL (-50): Royal Caribbean (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — negative guidance confirms price weakness.  
F (-40): Ford (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — negative sales headlines confirm downside momentum.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt.  
NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +13.31%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength.  
Key risk: tech dispersion (NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND) and sentiment-price divergences at NFLX and UNH warrant close monitoring.
